correctness.rationale: For every n>=4 and odd permutation Q, even vertices P have tr(Q^T P)<=n-2, with equality exactly when Q^T P is one transposition; this extends to the even-permutation convex hull. Because Q-X has zero row/column sums, Schatten duality against Q-J (orthogonal rank n-1 projector) gives dist_Sp(Q,E_n)>=2(n-1)^(1/p-1), including endpoints. The mean of all transpositions is ((n-3)/(n-1))I+2J/(n-1), so Q times that mean lies in the even hull and attains bound with n-1 identical singular values. Every full Birkhoff point is a convex mixture of even/odd vertices, which bounds the Hausdorff maximum by the same distance. The trace-contact transposition matrices have distinct off-diagonal entries, so define an exposed simplex; strict convexity of Schatten p for 1<p<infinity proves unique closest and no additional farthest nonvertex points. Independently enumerated permutation parity and transposition faces for n=4..7, yielding squared Frobenius gaps 4/(n-1), consistent with the formula, with no finite-to-infinite inference.
